What this plugin does

Plugin Validator puts common extension checks behind an administrator UI. The current engines integrate EduardoKrausME/moodle-plugin-validate and moodlehq/moodle-plugin-ci, while the interface leaves room for additional validators.

The key implementation choice is that the plugin does not start arbitrary CLI commands. Moodle Plugin Validate is loaded as a PHP library, and Moodle Plugin CI is loaded from its PHAR so savepoints, validate and PHPCS can run in the current PHP process.

Features you get
Plugin-type navigation
Browse plugin types that contain installed third-party extensions.
Plugin details
Inspect a selected extension and the validation engines available for it.
Structured validator output
Group Moodle Plugin Validate checks by validation rule.
Plugin CI integration
Run savepoints, validate and PHPCS from the loaded PHAR.
Self-validation
Allow local_pluginvalidator to validate itself because it is an extension plugin.
Engine updates
Manage upstream validation tooling without bundling shell execution.
